basis: Actual native PNGs inspected against canonical mom turnaround. A2-neutral and source use identical render helper hash, cameras and lights.
visible_progress: Skin is lighter/peachier than source; not claimed as an exact on-screen hex match.
Waist is less cinched; cheeks/chin fuller; nose projection slightly reduced.
Brows thinner and warm brown instead of the dark solid source brows.
visible_limitations: Face identity is still clearly Rain, not an exact canonical-mom likeness; eye shape, lips and facial planes need further authored work.
Haircut, hair color, stock scarf/top/jeans/shoes remain source; stock clothing design intentionally unchanged in this phase.

Closed-eye rendering has an unconvincing lower/outer eyelash contour and swollen/blank-looking lid surface. Visible in BOTH original and candidate under this actuator setup: not introduced solely by the adaptation, but not artistically accepted.
Smile actuator now genuinely moves geometry (about 6.4mm max), but expression remains too restrained for acting acceptance.
Hair specular highlights are overly white/glossy; no final look-development pass.
No complete body-pose/animation sweep, speech, phoneme timing or anatomical certification. One original invalid spine driver persists.

technical_observations.native_controls: Source and candidate blink/Smile drivers actuated, not direct key overrides. Actuation != visually correct performance.

next_steps: Inspect paired upper/lower eyelid controls and lash weights; do not approve the current single-upper-control blink.
Author face changes toward reference: nose/lips/orbits/cheek planes, preserving controls and comparing multiple views.
Test restrained acting and intermediate frames before considering clothing redesign.
